defectsRegister.title: Minimum Cost to Connect Two Groups of Points
defectsRegister.defect: Problem #499 was omitted from level23 generator, leaving problem bank at 498 problems.
defectsRegister.failingInput: Phase 1 Structural Audit comparison against canonical 500 roadmap
defectsRegister.expected: Problem #499 implemented with full test tiers, optimal/suboptimal solutions, and oracle
defectsRegister.actual: Missing problem definition (level23 ended at problem #498)
defectsRegister.rootCause: AI generator stopped generation at problem #498 before completing the 500-question roadmap collection.
defectsRegister.fix: Implemented complete Problem #499 with bitmask DP optimal solution, recursive memoized suboptimal solution, reference oracle, and 12 multi-tier test cases.

defectsRegister.title: Minimum Number of Vertices to Reach All Nodes
defectsRegister.defect: Problem #500 was omitted from level23 generator.
defectsRegister.failingInput: Phase 1 Structural Audit comparison against canonical 500 roadmap
defectsRegister.expected: Problem #500 implemented with full test tiers, optimal/suboptimal solutions, and oracle
defectsRegister.actual: Missing problem definition (level23 ended at problem #498)
defectsRegister.rootCause: AI generator stopped generation at problem #498 before completing the 500-question roadmap collection.
defectsRegister.fix: Implemented complete Problem #500 with Uint8Array in-degree tracking optimal solution, array-based suboptimal solution, reference oracle, and 12 multi-tier test cases.

defectsRegister.title: Find Peak Element
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution used linear search and claimed O(N) when interviewers expect comparison between iterative and recursive binary search paradigms.
defectsRegister.expected: Clean alternative recursive binary search with accurate O(log N) space complexity description
defectsRegister.actual: Suboptimal solution had linear scanning loop without recursive alternative structure
defectsRegister.rootCause: O(N) linear search was provided without offering the standard algorithmic alternative.
defectsRegister.fix: Updated suboptimal solution to recursive binary search with O(log N) space complexity description.

defectsRegister.title: Basic Calculator II
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution called undefined function evalRPN_convert throwing ReferenceError.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Placeholder helper function name was emitted as string without implementation.
defectsRegister.fix: Implemented complete token-by-token parsing suboptimal solution using stack arithmetic.

defectsRegister.title: Convert Sorted Array to Binary Search Tree
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution returned raw TreeNode object instead of treeToArray serialization.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Suboptimal solution omitted treeToArray wrapper needed by execution engine comparison.
defectsRegister.fix: Wrapped recursive tree construction in treeToArray(build(0, nums.length - 1)).

defectsRegister.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution used raw JSON.stringify/JSON.parse which bypassed tree formatting requirements.
defectsRegister.actual: JSON literal strings incompatible with treeToArray expectations
defectsRegister.rootCause: Trivial JSON serialization shortcut in place of tree traversal.
defectsRegister.fix: Implemented robust treeToArray array mapping and comma-delimited string parsing.

defectsRegister.title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution returned raw TreeNode object without treeToArray serialization.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Omitted treeToArray wrapper call on the root node.
defectsRegister.fix: Wrapped recursive helper in treeToArray(helper(preorder, inorder)).

defectsRegister.title: Serialize and Deserialize BST
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution returned TreeNode object on deserialization instead of treeToArray.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Omitted treeToArray wrapper in deserialize method.

defectsRegister.title: Subsets
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution used iterative cascading array expansion without clear DFS recursive structure.
defectsRegister.expected: Consistent DFS backtracking exploration with explicit complexity description
defectsRegister.rootCause: Suboptimal solution did not demonstrate alternative recursive DFS exploration pattern.
defectsRegister.fix: Updated to recursive DFS exploration with explicit path copy complexity documentation.

defectsRegister.title: Letter Case Permutation
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution used array.map concatenation causing excessive intermediate string copies.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Functional array-mapping idiom replaced structured recursive branching.
defectsRegister.fix: Implemented clean DFS recursion branching on character casing with O(2^N * N) complexity.

defectsRegister.title: Redundant Connection
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution allocated adjacency list size edges.length + 1. When node IDs exceeded edge count, adj[u] threw TypeError.
defectsRegister.failingInput: edges = [[1,3],[3,4],[1,4]] (n=3 edges, but max node ID is 4)
defectsRegister.actual: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "length")
defectsRegister.rootCause: Assumed node IDs were bounded by edges.length without inspecting max node ID across edge pairs.
defectsRegister.fix: Calculated maxNode dynamically: let maxNode = 0; for (const [u, v] of edges) maxNode = Math.max(maxNode, u, v); Array.from({ length: maxNode + 1 }).

defectsRegister.title: Minimum Genetic Mutation
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution returned -1 when startGene === endGene if endGene was not in bank.
defectsRegister.fix: Placed if (startGene === endGene) return 0; guard at the start of the function.

defectsRegister.title: Alien Dictionary
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal DFS solution produced non-deterministic topological sort differing from the platform BFS order.
defectsRegister.rootCause: DFS post-order traversal yields different valid topological order than lexicographically sorted BFS queue.
defectsRegister.fix: Standardized suboptimal implementation to Kahn BFS with queue.sort() tie-breaking.

defectsRegister.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal DP solution iterated i downwards from n-1, returning "aba" instead of earlier substring "bab" for "babad".
defectsRegister.rootCause: Reverse i loop overwrote earlier maximum length palindromes with later ones of equal length.
defectsRegister.fix: Changed DP table iteration to length-based ascending order len = 2..n, i = 0..n-len to preserve earliest occurrence.

defectsRegister.title: Magnetic Force Between Two Balls
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution executed linear search d = 1..10^9 on distance, timing out on large coordinates.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Linear scan over distance domain up to 10^9.
defectsRegister.fix: Replaced linear loop with binary search on distance with O(N log(max_pos)) time complexity.

defectsRegister.title: Palindrome Pairs
defectsRegister.defect: Optimal solution and suboptimal solution produced palindrome index pairs in different relative order, causing false WRONG_ANSWER.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Problem statement allows returning pairs in any order, but equality check expected exact array order.
defectsRegister.fix: Canonicalized optimal solution, suboptimal solution, and oracleFn to sort returned pairs by [i, j].

defectsRegister.title: Concatenated Words
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution iterated dictionary in original input order while optimal solution sorted by length, causing list mismatch.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Unsorted word iteration in suboptimal DFS.
defectsRegister.fix: Added words.sort((a, b) => a.length - b.length) to suboptimal solution to match canonical length ordering.

defectsRegister.title: Decode Ways II
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution contained an unfinished stub with comment "// compute dp[i]" returning 0 for all inputs.
defectsRegister.rootCause: Generated solution was an unwritten placeholder.
defectsRegister.fix: Implemented complete 1D DP BigInt recurrence table with modular arithmetic handling * transitions.

defectsRegister.title: Range Module
defectsRegister.defect: Suboptimal solution contained comments "// merge intervals" and "// linear scan" without implementing addRange/removeRange logic.
defectsRegister.fix: Implemented complete linear interval scanning class for addRange, removeRange, and queryRange.
